### BloomFormControl  [abstract class]
```dart
abstract class BloomFormControl
```
Abstract base contract for all reactive Bloom form controls.

Provides a unified reactive state surface across single-value inputs ([BloomFormField],
[BloomTypedFormField]), file attachments ([BloomFileField]), repeating collections
([BloomFieldArray]), and nested sub-forms ([BloomFormGroup]).

Both browser DOM mounting and SSR evaluate these signals seamlessly.

```dart
void inspectControl(BloomFormControl control) {
  if (!control.isValid.value) {
    print('Validation errors: ${control.errors.value}');
  }
}
```

Members:
  - `Signal<List<String>> get errors`  -- Reactive signal containing validation error messages generated by [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `ReadonlySignal<bool> get isDirty`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether user actions have modified the initial value.
  - `Signal<bool> get isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether the user has interacted with or blurred this control.
  - `ReadonlySignal<bool> get isValid`  -- Computed signal that evaluates to `true` when [errors] is empty and all children are valid.
  - `ReadonlySignal<bool> get isValidating`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether asynchronous validation is currently executing.
  - `dynamic get rawValue`  -- Raw untyped value of the control used during form serialization and aggregation.
  - `bool validate()`  -- Validates this control and any child controls synchronously, updating [errors].
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false})`  -- Validates this control and any child controls asynchronously, updating [errors].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets this control to its initial state, clearing [errors], [isDirty], and [isTouched].
  - `void touch()`  -- Marks this control as touched (e.g. on blur or user interaction).

### BloomFormField  [class]
```dart
class BloomFormField implements BloomFormControl
```
Reactive state controller for an individual string form input field.

Tracks input state, error messages, dirty/touched flags, and validation status
using fine-grained `signals` primitives. Supports both synchronous validators
and asynchronous validators with debouncing and stale-result discard.

### Validation Timing
Setting the field value via [setValue] updates [value] and marks [isDirty] as `true`,
but does **not** run validators automatically. Validation runs when [validate],
[validateAsync], or [validateDebounced] is explicitly invoked.

### Reactive State
- [value]: Current string value as a `Signal<String>`.
- [errors]: List of active validation error strings as a `Signal<List<String>>`.
- [isDirty]: `true` if [setValue] has been called since instantiation or [reset].
- [isTouched]: `true` after [touch] is called (e.g. on blur).
- [isValid]: Computed `ReadonlySignal<bool>` that evaluates to `true` when [errors] is empty.
- [isValidating]: Reactive `ReadonlySignal<bool>` indicating whether async checks are in flight.

```dart
final username = BloomFormField(
  initialValue: '',
  validators: [required(), minLength(3)],
  asyncValidators: [
    (val) async => await api.isAvailable(val) ? null : 'Username is taken.',
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `final List<String? Function(String)> validators`  -- Ordered list of synchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `final List<Future<String?> Function(String)> asyncValidators`  -- Ordered list of asynchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validateAsync].
  - `final Duration asyncDebounce`  -- Debounce duration applied when [validateAsync] is called with `debounce: true`.
  - `late final Signal<String> value`  -- Reactive signal containing the current field value.
  - `late final Signal<List<String>> errors`  -- Reactive signal containing validation error messages generated by [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `late final Signal<bool> isDirty`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether [setValue] has modified the initial value.
  - `late final Signal<bool> isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether the user has interacted with or blurred this field.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal that evaluates to `true` when [errors] is empty.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating = _isValidating.readonly()`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether asynchronous validation is currently executing.
  - `BloomFormField({ String initialValue = '', this.validators = const [], this.asyncValidators = const [], this.asyncDebounce = const Duration(milliseconds: 300), }) : _initialValue = initialValue`  -- Creates a form field controller with optional [initialValue], [validators], and [asyncValidators].
  - `dynamic get rawValue => value.value`  -- Untyped access to the string value.
  - `void setValue(String newValue)`  -- Updates the field's [value] and marks [isDirty] as `true`.
  - `void touch() => isTouched.value = true`  -- Marks [isTouched] as `true` to indicate user interaction (e.g. on blur).
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs all [validators] against the current [value] synchronously and updates [errors].
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Runs synchronous validators first, and if they pass, evaluates all [asyncValidators].
  - `Future<bool> validateDebounced([Duration? delay])`  -- Triggers debounced asynchronous validation using [delay] or [asyncDebounce].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets [value] back to its initial value, clears [errors], and sets [isDirty] and [isTouched] to `false`.

### BloomTypedFormField  [class]
```dart
class BloomTypedFormField<T> implements BloomFormControl
```
Reactive state controller for an individual strongly-typed form input field.

Manages arbitrary value types [T] such as [int], [double], [bool], [DateTime],
enums, or custom domain models with fine-grained reactivity.

Both browser DOM mounting and SSR evaluate these signals seamlessly.

```dart
final ageField = BloomTypedFormField<int>(
  initialValue: 18,
  validators: [min(13, 'Must be at least 13 years old.')],
  asyncValidators: [
    (age) async => await checkAgeEligibility(age),
  ],
);

ageField.setValue(21);
```

Members:
  - `final List<String? Function(T)> validators`  -- Ordered list of synchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `final List<Future<String?> Function(T)> asyncValidators`  -- Ordered list of asynchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validateAsync].
  - `final Duration asyncDebounce`  -- Debounce duration applied when [validateAsync] is called with `debounce: true`.
  - `late final Signal<T> value`  -- Reactive signal containing the current typed field value.
  - `late final Signal<List<String>> errors`  -- Reactive signal containing validation error messages generated by [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `late final Signal<bool> isDirty`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether [setValue] has modified the initial value.
  - `late final Signal<bool> isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether the user has interacted with or blurred this field.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal that evaluates to `true` when [errors] is empty.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating = _isValidating.readonly()`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether asynchronous validation is currently executing.
  - `BloomTypedFormField({ required T initialValue, this.validators = const [], this.asyncValidators = const [], this.asyncDebounce = const Duration(milliseconds: 300), }) : _initialValue = initialValue`  -- Creates a typed form field controller with [initialValue], optional [validators], and [asyncValidators].
  - `dynamic get rawValue => value.value`  -- Untyped access to the typed value.
  - `void setValue(T newValue)`  -- Updates the field's [value] and marks [isDirty] as `true`.
  - `void touch() => isTouched.value = true`  -- Marks [isTouched] as `true` to indicate user interaction (e.g. on blur).
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs all [validators] against the current [value] synchronously and updates [errors].
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Runs synchronous validators first, and if they pass, evaluates all [asyncValidators].
  - `Future<bool> validateDebounced([Duration? delay])`  -- Triggers debounced asynchronous validation using [delay] or [asyncDebounce].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets [value] back to its initial value, clears [errors], and sets [isDirty] and [isTouched] to `false`.

### BloomField  [typedef]
```dart
typedef BloomField<T> = BloomTypedFormField<T>
```
Generic shorthand alias for [BloomTypedFormField].

### BloomFile  [class]
```dart
class BloomFile
```
Platform-neutral file descriptor for file inputs and attachments.

Keeps `form.dart` pure Dart without requiring browser DOM `package:web` imports,
ensuring safe usage in Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Dart VM unit tests.
In browser execution, [rawFile] holds an opaque reference to the browser's native `web.File`.

```dart
final document = BloomFile(
  name: 'specs.pdf',
  size: 1024 * 1024,
  mimeType: 'application/pdf',
);
```

Members:
  - `final String name`  -- The filename without path (e.g. `'photo.png'`).
  - `final int size`  -- The file size in bytes.
  - `final String mimeType`  -- The MIME media type (e.g. `'image/png'`, `'application/pdf'`).
  - `final DateTime? lastModified`  -- Timestamp of when the file was last modified, if available.
  - `final Object? rawFile`  -- Opaque handle to the underlying platform file instance (e.g. `web.File` in browser DOM).
  - `const BloomFile({ required this.name, this.size = 0, this.mimeType = '', this.lastModified, this.rawFile, })`  -- Creates a platform-neutral [BloomFile] descriptor.
  - `String get extension`  -- Returns the lowercase file extension including the leading period (e.g. `'.png'`),
  - `String toString() =>`
  - `int get hashCode =>`

### BloomFileField  [class]
```dart
class BloomFileField implements BloomFormControl
```
Reactive controller for `<input type="file">` file selection fields.

Holds the list of selected [BloomFile] instances reactively and supports single
or multiple selection modes along with dedicated file validators (e.g. [maxFileSize],
[allowedExtensions], [allowedMimeTypes], [minFiles], [maxFiles]).

Safe for both browser DOM mounting and SSR rendering.

```dart
final avatarField = BloomFileField(
  multiple: false,
  validators: [
    fileRequired('Please choose an avatar image.'),
    maxFileSize(2 * 1024 * 1024, 'Avatar must be smaller than 2MB.'),
    allowedExtensions(['.png', '.jpg', '.webp']),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `final bool multiple`  -- Whether this field accepts multiple files.
  - `final List<String? Function(List<BloomFile>)> validators`  -- Ordered list of synchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `final List<Future<String?> Function(List<BloomFile>)> asyncValidators`  -- Ordered list of asynchronous validator callbacks evaluated on [validateAsync].
  - `final Duration asyncDebounce`  -- Debounce duration applied when [validateAsync] is called with `debounce: true`.
  - `late final Signal<List<BloomFile>> value`  -- Reactive signal containing the list of currently selected [BloomFile] items.
  - `late final Signal<List<String>> errors`  -- Reactive signal containing validation error messages generated by [validate] or [validateAsync].
  - `late final Signal<bool> isDirty`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether the file selection has been modified.
  - `late final Signal<bool> isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether the user has interacted with this field.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal that evaluates to `true` when [errors] is empty.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating = _isValidating.readonly()`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether asynchronous validation is currently executing.
  - `BloomFileField({ List<BloomFile> initialValue = const [], this.multiple = false, this.validators = const [], this.asyncValidators = const [], this.asyncDebounce = const Duration(milliseconds: 300), }) : _initialValue = List.unmodifiable(initialValue)`  -- Creates a reactive file input controller.
  - `BloomFile? get file => value.value.isEmpty ? null : value.value.first`  -- Convenience getter returning the first selected [BloomFile], or `null` if empty.
  - `List<BloomFile> get files => value.value`  -- Returns the current list of selected files.
  - `dynamic get rawValue => value.value`  -- Untyped access to the selected files list.
  - `void setFiles(List<BloomFile> newFiles)`  -- Updates the selected files and marks [isDirty] as `true`.
  - `void setFile(BloomFile? singleFile)`  -- Sets a single selected file (or clears selection if `null`) and marks [isDirty] as `true`.
  - `void clear() => setFiles(const [])`  -- Clears all selected files and marks [isDirty] as `true`.
  - `void touch() => isTouched.value = true`  -- Marks [isTouched] as `true` to indicate user interaction (e.g. on change or blur).
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs all [validators] against the current [value] synchronously and updates [errors].
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Runs synchronous validators first, and if they pass, evaluates all [asyncValidators].
  - `Future<bool> validateDebounced([Duration? delay])`  -- Triggers debounced asynchronous validation using [delay] or [asyncDebounce].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets the selected files back to initial value and clears [errors], [isDirty], and [isTouched].

### BloomFieldArray  [class]
```dart
class BloomFieldArray<T extends BloomFormControl> implements BloomFormControl
```
Reactive controller for a repeating collection of child form controls or sub-forms.

Supports adding, removing, and reordering child items reactively. Adding or removing
entries automatically updates the [fields] signal, notifying reactive boundaries.

```dart
final todoItems = BloomFieldArray<BloomFormField>(
  initialValues: [
    BloomFormField(initialValue: 'First task'),
  ],
);

todoItems.add(BloomFormField(initialValue: 'Second task'));
```

Members:
  - `final List<T> Function()? _itemFactory`
  - `late final Signal<List<T>> fields`  -- Reactive signal holding the ordered list of child controls.
  - `late final Signal<List<String>> errors`  -- Reactive signal containing array-level validation errors.
  - `late final Signal<bool> isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether this array has been interacted with.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isDirty`  -- Computed signal indicating whether any child is dirty or the array membership has changed.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when all child controls are valid and array-level [errors] is empty.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether array-level or child-level validation is currently in flight.
  - `final List<String? Function(List<T>)> validators`  -- Optional array-level synchronous validators (e.g. [minItems], [maxItems]).
  - `final List<Future<String?> Function(List<T>)> asyncValidators`  -- Optional array-level asynchronous validators.
  - `final Duration asyncDebounce`  -- Debounce duration applied when [validateAsync] is called with `debounce: true`.
  - `BloomFieldArray({ List<T> initialValues = const [], List<T> Function()? itemFactory, this.validators = const [], this.asyncValidators = const [], this.asyncDebounce = const Duration(milliseconds: 300), }) : _itemFactory = itemFactory, _initialControls = List.unmodifiable(initialValues)`  -- Creates a reactive field array initialized with [initialValues] or an optional [itemFactory].
  - `int get length => fields.value.length`  -- Returns the current number of child controls in the array.
  - `dynamic get rawValue => fields.value.map((c) => c.rawValue).toList()`  -- Returns the raw untyped list of child control values.
  - `void add(T control)`  -- Appends [control] to the end of the array.
  - `void insert(int index, T control)`  -- Inserts [control] at position [index].
  - `T removeAt(int index)`  -- Removes and returns the control at [index].
  - `bool remove(T control)`  -- Removes the first occurrence of [control] from the array.
  - `void move(int oldIndex, int newIndex)`  -- Moves a control from [oldIndex] to [newIndex].
  - `void clear()`  -- Clears all child controls from the array.
  - `void touch()`  -- Marks this array and all its child controls as touched.
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs array-level [validators] and triggers [validate] on every child control.
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Asynchronously validates all child controls and evaluates array-level [asyncValidators].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets the array back to its initial controls and resets each child.

### BloomFormArray  [typedef]
```dart
typedef BloomFormArray<T extends BloomFormControl> = BloomFieldArray<T>
```
Alias for [BloomFieldArray] representing a repeating list of form controls.

### BloomFormGroup  [class]
```dart
class BloomFormGroup implements BloomFormControl
```
Reactive controller for a nested group of named form controls.

Implements [BloomFormControl] so nested groups can be composed hierarchically
within [BloomForm] or [BloomFieldArray].

```dart
final addressGroup = BloomFormGroup({
  'street': BloomFormField(validators: [required()]),
  'city': BloomFormField(validators: [required()]),
});
```

Members:
  - `late final Signal<List<String>> errors`  -- Reactive signal containing group-level validation errors.
  - `late final Signal<bool> isTouched`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether this group has been touched.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when every child control's `isValid` is `true`
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isDirty`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when at least one child control's `isDirty` is `true`.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether group-level or child-level validation is currently running.
  - `final List<String? Function(Map<String, dynamic>)> validators`  -- Optional group-level synchronous validators evaluated against the raw value map.
  - `final List<Future<String?> Function(Map<String, dynamic>)> asyncValidators`  -- Optional group-level asynchronous validators evaluated against the raw value map.
  - `final Duration asyncDebounce`  -- Debounce duration applied when [validateAsync] is called with `debounce: true`.
  - `BloomFormGroup( Map<String, BloomFormControl> fields,`  -- Creates a [BloomFormGroup] managing the given map of named [fields].
  - `Map<String, BloomFormControl> get fields => _fields`  -- Map of all registered child controls.
  - `T getControl<T extends BloomFormControl>(String name)`  -- Returns the registered control under [name] typed as [T].
  - `BloomFormField getField(String name) => getControl<BloomFormField>(name)`  -- Returns the [BloomFormField] registered under [name].
  - `Map<String, dynamic> get rawValue =>`  -- Untyped structured map of all child values.
  - `Map<String, dynamic> get rawValues => rawValue`  -- Snapshot map of all child values keyed by field name.
  - `Map<String, String> get values =>`  -- Snapshot map of string representations of child values.
  - `String getValue(String name)`  -- Returns the string value of the field registered under [name].
  - `void touch()`  -- Marks this group and all its child controls as touched.
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs group-level [validators] and [validate] on every child control.
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Asynchronously validates all child controls and evaluates group-level [asyncValidators].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets all child controls to their initial values and clears [errors] and [isTouched].

### BloomSubForm  [typedef]

```dart
typedef BloomSubForm = BloomFormGroup
```
Alias for [BloomFormGroup] representing a nested sub-form.

### BloomNestedForm  [typedef]

```dart
typedef BloomNestedForm = BloomFormGroup
```

### BloomForm  [class]
```dart
class BloomForm
```
Reactive controller for a collection of named form controls.

Coordinates cross-field validation, dirty tracking, submission lifecycle,
and form reset operations across mixed field types (strings, numbers, booleans,
files, field arrays, and nested sub-forms).

### Submission Lifecycle
Calling [submit] or [submitRaw] executes the following sequence:
1. Runs [validateAsync] across all registered controls and awaits completion.
2. If any control fails validation, submission halts immediately and callback is not called.
3. If validation succeeds, [isSubmitting] is set to `true`.
4. Awaits the callback with a snapshot of values.
5. In a `finally` block, resets [isSubmitting] back to `false`.

```dart
final profileForm = BloomForm({
  'username': BloomFormField(validators: [required(), minLength(3)]),
  'age': BloomTypedFormField<int>(initialValue: 25, validators: [min(18)]),
  'avatar': BloomFileField(validators: [fileRequired()]),
  'agree': BloomTypedFormField<bool>(initialValue: false, validators: [requiredTrue()]),
  'skills': BloomFieldArray<BloomFormField>(
    initialValues: [BloomFormField(initialValue: 'Dart')],
  ),
});

await profileForm.submitRaw((data) async {
  print('Submitted data: $data');
});
```

Members:
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValid`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when every registered field's [BloomFormControl.isValid] is `true`.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isDirty`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when at least one registered field's [BloomFormControl.isDirty] is `true`.
  - `late final ReadonlySignal<bool> isValidating`  -- Computed signal returning `true` when any registered field's [BloomFormControl.isValidating] is `true`.
  - `final Signal<bool> isSubmitting = signal(false)`  -- Reactive signal indicating whether an asynchronous submit handler is currently running.
  - `BloomForm(Map<String, BloomFormControl> fields) : _fields = fields`  -- Creates a [BloomForm] controller managing the provided map of named [fields].
  - `Map<String, BloomFormControl> get fields => _fields`  -- Map of all registered controls in the form.
  - `T getControl<T extends BloomFormControl>(String name)`  -- Returns the registered control under [name] typed as [T].
  - `BloomFormField getField(String name)`  -- Returns the [BloomFormField] registered under [name].
  - `String getValue(String name)`  -- Returns the current string value of the field registered under [name].
  - `Map<String, String> get values =>`  -- Returns a snapshot map of all current field string values keyed by field name.
  - `Map<String, dynamic> get rawValues =>`  -- Returns a structured map containing untyped/raw values of all registered fields.
  - `Map<String, dynamic> get data => rawValues`  -- Alias for [rawValues] returning the structured values of all registered fields.
  - `void touch()`  -- Marks all registered fields as touched.
  - `bool validate()`  -- Runs `validate()` on every registered field synchronously.
  - `Future<bool> validateAsync({bool debounce = false}) async`  -- Runs asynchronous validation across all registered controls concurrently.
  - `Future<void> submit( Future<void> Function(Map<String, String> values) onSubmit) async`  -- Validates all fields asynchronously and executes [onSubmit] if validation succeeds.
  - `Future<void> submitRaw( Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> values) onSubmit) async`  -- Validates all fields asynchronously and executes [onSubmit] with structured [rawValues] if validation succeeds.
  - `Future<void> submitData( Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> values) onSubmit) =>`  -- Alias for [submitRaw] taking structured values.
  - `Future<void> submitAsync( Future<void> Function(Map<String, String> values) onSubmit) =>`  -- Asynchronous counterpart to [submit].
  - `Future<void> submitRawAsync( Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> values) onSubmit) =>`  -- Asynchronous counterpart to [submitRaw].
  - `Future<void> submitDataAsync( Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> values) onSubmit) =>`  -- Asynchronous counterpart to [submitData].
  - `void reset()`  -- Resets all registered fields to their initial values and clears [isSubmitting].

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## framework.dart
Availability: core (package:bloom_js_native/bloom_js_native.dart)

### BloomContext  [class]
```dart
class BloomContext<T>
```
Token representing an ambient context value of type [T].

Context allows passing data down through a subtree without manually threading
properties through every intermediate component ("prop drilling"). A context
is created via [createContext], injected into a subtree via [provide], and
consumed inside descendant components via [useContext].

### Zone-Based Propagation and Limitations
Context values are propagated through Dart [Zone] values captured during
synchronous tree mounting and SSR rendering.

**Important Gotcha**: When a reactive boundary (such as [Live] or [Show])
rebuilds in response to a signal update, its builder callback executes in
the [Zone] captured when that reactive effect was originally mounted. If an
ancestor provider dynamically changes the value it supplies, descendant
reactive rebuilds will continue to read the value from their initial mount zone
unless the provider itself triggers a rebuild of the entire subtree. For dynamic
state that changes over time, use `Signal<T>` instead of relying on mutable context.

```dart
final themeContext = createContext('light');

BloomNode themedCard() {
  final theme = useContext(themeContext);
  return Div(
    className: 'card card-$theme',
    text: 'Current theme: $theme',
  );
}

BloomNode app() => themeContext.provide(
  'dark',
  Div(
    children: [
      themedCard(),
    ],
  ),
);
```

Members:
  - `final T defaultValue`  -- The fallback value returned by [useContext] when no matching provider
  - `final Object zoneKey = Object()`  -- The unique key used to look up and store this context's value within
  - `BloomContext(this.defaultValue)`  -- Creates a new ambient [BloomContext] token with the specified [defaultValue].
  - `BloomNode provide(T value, BloomNode child) =>`  -- Provides [value] to all children in the [child] subtree.

### createContext  [function]
```dart
BloomContext<T> createContext<T>(T defaultValue) => BloomContext<T>(defaultValue)
```
Creates a typed ambient [BloomContext] with [defaultValue].

Returns a context token that can be passed to [BloomContext.provide] to
inject a value into a subtree, and to [useContext] to read the nearest
provided value within that subtree.

```dart
final authContext = createContext<User?>(null);
```

### useContext  [function]
```dart
T useContext<T>(BloomContext<T> context)
```
Reads the current ambient value for [context] from the surrounding [Zone].

If an ancestor [ContextProviderNode] provided a value for [context], that
value is returned. If no provider is found in the current zone hierarchy,
returns `context.defaultValue`.

### Reactive Note
Calling [useContext] is not reactive by itself. If you need UI to update when
context data changes, store a `Signal<T>` in the context and read `signal.value`
inside a [Live] or [Show] boundary.

```dart
BloomNode userBadge() {
  final user = useContext(authContext);
  return Span(
    text: user != null ? 'Logged in as ${user.name}' : 'Anonymous',
  );
}
```

### ContextProviderNode  [class]
```dart
class ContextProviderNode<T> extends BloomNode
```
AST node that injects context [value] into its descendant [child] tree.

During SSR (`renderToHtml`) and DOM mounting (`mount`), [ContextProviderNode]
executes the rendering of [child] within a [runZoned] block carrying
`{context.zoneKey: value}` in `zoneValues`.

This node does not emit any wrapper HTML elements or sentinel comments; it
acts as a pure scoping boundary for ambient context lookups.

Usually created via [BloomContext.provide] rather than directly instantiating this class.

Members:
  - `final BloomContext<T> context`  -- The [BloomContext] token being provided.
  - `final T value`  -- The value injected into the ambient zone for [child] and its descendants.
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The descendant subtree that has access to [value].
  - `const ContextProviderNode(this.context, this.value, this.child)`  -- Creates a [ContextProviderNode] associating [context] with [value] over [child].

### BloomNode  [sealed class]
```dart
sealed class BloomNode
```
The core descriptor tree root — pure Dart, zero DOM dependency.

Every Bloom component compiles to a [BloomNode] AST tree first.
Zero browser or DOM APIs are imported by `framework.dart`, allowing
descriptor trees to be constructed and evaluated anywhere Dart runs:

- **Browser Mount**: `mount(node, '#app')` in `package:bloom_js_native/browser.dart`
  creates real DOM nodes via `package:web` and sets up fine-grained `signals` effects.
- **SSR / SSG**: `renderToHtml(node)` in `package:bloom_js_native/bloom_js_native.dart`
  evaluates the tree to an HTML string in `<1ms` with full HTML entity escaping.
- **Testing**: Descriptors can be inspected, traversed, and tested in pure Dart VM tests
  without headless browsers.

Members:
  - `const BloomNode()`  -- Base const constructor for all [BloomNode] descriptors.

### TextNode  [class]
```dart
class TextNode extends BloomNode
```
Plain text leaf descriptor.

Mounts to a single `web.Text` DOM node via `web.document.createTextNode(text)`
in the browser. During server-side rendering (`renderToHtml`), the text is
sanitized via [escapeHtml] to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS).

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Text].

Members:
  - `final String text`  -- The raw text content of this node.
  - `const TextNode(this.text)`  -- Creates a text leaf descriptor with [text].

### ElNode  [class]
```dart
class ElNode extends BloomNode
```
HTML element descriptor.

Represents an HTML or custom element in the Bloom descriptor tree.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Creates a `web.Element` matching [tag] via
  `web.document.createElement(tag)`. Applies [className], [style], [attrs],
  registers event listeners from [on], creates an optional text child node if
  [text] is non-null, and recursively mounts [children].
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Emits `<tag [class] [style] [attrs]>...children</tag>`
  with all attributes and text contents HTML-escaped. If [tag] is a standard
  HTML void element (e.g. `img`, `input`, `br`, `hr`), it is emitted without
  a closing tag and any children are omitted.

Most HTML elements have dedicated sugar subclasses such as [Div], [Span],
[Button], [Input], [Form], and [A]. Use [ElNode] or [El] directly when creating
custom elements or tags without a dedicated sugar class.

Members:
  - `final String tag`  -- Lowercase tag name, e.g. "div", "button", "custom-tag".
  - `final String? text`  -- Optional single text child sugar — equivalent to `children: [Text(text)]`
  - `final String? className`  -- CSS class attribute applied to the element.
  - `final String? style`  -- Inline style — raw CSS string (e.g. "color: red; display: flex;").
  - `final Map<String, String>? attrs`  -- Arbitrary HTML attributes (id, href, placeholder, etc.).
  - `final Map<String, BloomEventHandler>? on`  -- Event handlers keyed by DOM event name (click, input, change...).
  - `final List<BloomNode> children`  -- Child descriptors nested within this element.
  - `const ElNode( this.tag,`  -- Creates an element descriptor with [tag] and optional styling, attributes,

### FragmentNode  [class]
```dart
class FragmentNode extends BloomNode
```
Fragment — groups multiple child nodes without introducing a wrapper DOM element.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Appends each child in [children] sequentially into the
  parent DOM container without creating an intermediate container node.
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Renders each child in [children] sequentially into
  the output stream with no wrapper tags.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Fragment].

Members:
  - `final List<BloomNode> children`  -- The list of child descriptors grouped by this fragment.
  - `const FragmentNode([this.children = const []])`  -- Creates a fragment descriptor containing [children].

### LiveNode  [class]
```dart
class LiveNode extends BloomNode
```
Reactive boundary — re-evaluates [builder] inside a signal effect
and patches only its own DOM region.

### DOM Mounting and Sentinels
In the browser, [LiveNode] mounts to a pair of sentinel comments:
`<!-- bloom:live -->` and `<!-- /bloom:live -->`.

It establishes a fine-grained `signals` effect that automatically tracks
all signal reads occurring synchronously within [builder]. When any tracked
signal updates, the effect runs:
1. Disposes all child effects, event listeners, and subscriptions owned by
   the previous subtree's `_Region`.
2. Executes [builder] to obtain the new descriptor tree.
3. Updates or reconciles the DOM nodes positioned strictly between the
   sentinel comments, leaving the surrounding DOM untouched.

### SSR Behavior
During server-side rendering (`renderToHtml`), [builder] is executed exactly
once synchronously to produce the static HTML output. No signals effects or
sentinels are created on the server.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Live].

Members:
  - `final BloomNode Function() builder`  -- The reactive builder callback invoked to produce this boundary's subtree.
  - `const LiveNode(this.builder)`  -- Creates a reactive boundary descriptor driven by [builder].

### MemoNode  [class]
```dart
class MemoNode<T> extends BloomNode
```
Memoization boundary — only re-evaluates [builder] when [dependency] produces
a value that differs (`!=`) from its previous value.

### DOM Mounting and Sentinels
In the browser, [MemoNode] mounts between a pair of sentinel comments:
`<!-- bloom:memo -->` and `<!-- /bloom:memo -->`.

Tracks signal reads inside [dependency]. When an upstream signal updates,
[dependency] is re-evaluated. If the returned value is identical or equal
(`==`) to the previous value, [builder] is **not** re-run and the existing DOM
is preserved. Only when the value changes (`!=`) is [builder] called with the
new value to update the DOM region.

### SSR Behavior
In SSR (`renderToHtml`), [dependency] is called once and its result is passed
to [builder] to render the initial markup.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Memo].

Members:
  - `final T Function() dependency`  -- Reactive computation returning the dependency value of type [T].
  - `final BloomNode Function(T value) builder`  -- Builder that produces a descriptor tree from the evaluated dependency [value].
  - `const MemoNode(this.dependency, this.builder)`  -- Creates a memoization boundary descriptor with [dependency] and [builder].
  - `Object? Function() get dependencyErased => dependency`  -- [dependency], viewed untyped as `Object? Function()`.
  - `BloomNode Function(Object? value) get builderErased =>`  -- [builder], accepting an untyped `Object?` dependency value.

### ShowNode  [class]
```dart
class ShowNode extends BloomNode
```
Conditional rendering primitive.

Mounts [child] when [when] evaluates to `true`, and optional [fallback]
when [when] evaluates to `false`.

### DOM Mounting and Sentinels
In the browser, [ShowNode] mounts between sentinel comments:
`<!-- bloom:show -->` and `<!-- /bloom:show -->`.

Evaluates [when] inside a signal effect. When the boolean result transitions
between `true` and `false`, the previous branch's scoped region is disposed
and the active branch ([child] or [fallback]) is mounted between the sentinels.
If [fallback] is null and [when] is `false`, an empty fragment is mounted.

### SSR Behavior
During SSR (`renderToHtml`), [when] is evaluated once synchronously. If `true`,
[child] is rendered; if `false`, [fallback] is rendered (or nothing if null).

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Show].

Members:
  - `final bool Function() when`  -- Reactive predicate — called inside a signals effect (browser) or once (SSR).
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The descriptor tree rendered when [when] evaluates to `true`.
  - `final BloomNode? fallback`  -- Optional descriptor tree rendered when [when] evaluates to `false`.
  - `const ShowNode(this.when,`  -- Creates a conditional rendering descriptor with predicate [when], primary

### ForEachNode  [class]
```dart
class ForEachNode<T> extends BloomNode
```
List rendering primitive. Re-reads [items] reactively; each item is
mapped through [builder] to a descriptor.

### DOM Mounting and Reconciliation
In the browser, [ForEachNode] mounts between sentinel comments:
`<!-- bloom:foreach -->` and `<!-- /bloom:foreach -->`.

- **Keyed lists (`keyFn != null`)**: Fine-grained list reconciliation.
  Each item is identified by the unique string returned from [keyFn]. When
  [items] updates, existing DOM nodes and reactive sub-regions for unchanged
  keys are retained and repositioned, new keys are mounted, and removed keys
  are disposed. This preserves input focus, text selection, and internal state.
- **Unkeyed lists (`keyFn == null`)**: When [items] updates, all existing child
  regions between the sentinels are disposed and rebuilt from scratch.

### SSR Behavior
During SSR (`renderToHtml`), [items] is called once synchronously and each
item is mapped via [builder] to render the child nodes in order.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [ForEach].

Members:
  - `final List<T> Function() items`  -- Reactive getter returning the list of items to render.
  - `final BloomNode Function(T item) builder`  -- Factory callback mapping each item of type [T] to its [BloomNode] descriptor.
  - `final String Function(T item)? keyFn`  -- Optional key extractor function returning a unique string identifier for [item].
  - `const ForEachNode(this.items, this.builder,`  -- Creates a list rendering descriptor with [items], [builder], and optional [keyFn].
  - `List<BloomNode> buildChildren() =>`  -- Synchronously evaluates [items] and maps each element through [builder].
  - `List<Object?> Function() get itemsErased => items`  -- [items], viewed as an untyped list getter `List<Object?> Function()`.
  - `String Function(Object? item)? get keyFnErased`  -- [keyFn], accepting an untyped item `Object?`. Returns `null` when the list is unkeyed.
  - `BloomNode Function(Object? item) get builderErased =>`  -- [builder], accepting an untyped item `Object?`.

### StyleNode  [class]
```dart
class StyleNode extends BloomNode
```
Style element helper — emits `<style>css</style>`.

In the browser (`mount`), creates a `<style>` element containing [css]. If
`bloomStyleNonce` is configured, it is attached as the `nonce` attribute for
Content Security Policy (CSP) compliance.

In SSR (`renderToHtml`), outputs `<style>css</style>` with any closing `</`
sequences neutralized to prevent stylesheet breakout attacks.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Style].

Members:
  - `final String css`  -- The raw CSS stylesheet content.
  - `const StyleNode(this.css)`  -- Creates a style element descriptor with raw [css].

### RawHtmlNode  [class]
```dart
class RawHtmlNode extends BloomNode
```
Trusted raw HTML passthrough — rendered verbatim by both backends.

### Security Warning
**Never** pass unescaped user-supplied input to [RawHtmlNode] or [Raw].
This node bypasses HTML escaping completely and directly sets `.innerHTML`
in the browser, making the application vulnerable to XSS attacks if fed
untrusted data.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Mounts as a `<span>` element host whose `innerHTML`
  is assigned [html].
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Writes [html] directly into the output stream.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Raw].

Members:
  - `final String html`  -- The raw HTML string to insert.
  - `const RawHtmlNode(this.html)`  -- Creates a raw HTML passthrough descriptor with [html].

### AnimatedNode  [class]
```dart
class AnimatedNode extends BloomNode
```
AST node that wraps [child] with a CSS animation described by [animation].

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Emits a `<style>@keyframes ...</style>` block
  (deduplicated by animation name per render pass) and a wrapper `<div>`
  carrying the `animation:` inline style.
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Injects the `@keyframes` rule into `document.head`
  once per animation name for the lifetime of the page, and creates a wrapper
  `<div>` with the animation's inline style enclosing [child].

Members:
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The descriptor tree enclosed within the animated wrapper `<div>`.
  - `final BloomAnimation animation`  -- The animation configuration describing keyframes, duration, timing, and fill mode.
  - `const AnimatedNode({required this.child, required this.animation})`  -- Creates an animated wrapper descriptor enclosing [child] with [animation].

### Text  [class]
```dart
class Text extends TextNode
```
Plain text node sugar.

Mounts to a `web.Text` node in the browser and escapes text in SSR.

```dart
P(
  children: [
    const Text('Hello, '),
    Span(className: 'font-bold', text: 'World!'),
  ],
)
```

Members:
  - `const Text(super.text)`  -- Creates a plain text node with [text].

### Fragment  [class]
```dart
class Fragment extends FragmentNode
```
Fragment grouping sugar.

Groups multiple sibling nodes without introducing an additional wrapper DOM element.

```dart
Fragment(
  children: [
    H1(text: 'Title'),
    P(text: 'First paragraph'),
    P(text: 'Second paragraph'),
  ],
)
```

Members:
  - `const Fragment({required List<BloomNode> children}) : super(children)`  -- Creates a fragment from a named list of [children].
  - `const Fragment.fromList(super.children)`  -- Creates a fragment from a positional list of [children].

### Live  [class]
```dart
class Live extends LiveNode
```
Reactive text / subtree — the JSX `{expr}` equivalent.

Automatically tracks any `Signal` read during the execution of [builder]
and updates only this region when signals change.

### DOM Representation
Mounts between sentinel comments `<!-- bloom:live -->` and `<!-- /bloom:live -->`
rather than creating a wrapper element.

```dart
final count = signal(0);

BloomNode counterView() => Div(
  children: [
    Live(() => P(text: 'Current count: ${count.value}')),
    Button(
      text: 'Increment',
      onClick: (e) => count.value++,
    ),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `const Live(super.builder)`  -- Creates a reactive boundary descriptor driven by [builder].

### Memo  [class]
```dart
class Memo<T> extends MemoNode<T>
```
Memoization sugar.

Only re-evaluates [builder] when [dependency] returns a value that differs
(`!=`) from the previous execution. Prevents expensive subtree re-evaluations
when unrelated signals update.

### DOM Representation
Mounts between sentinel comments `<!-- bloom:memo -->` and `<!-- /bloom:memo -->`.

```dart
final activeUserId = signal('user-1');

BloomNode userProfileView() => Div(
  children: [
    Memo(
      () => activeUserId.value,
      (id) => Div(
        className: 'profile-card',
        text: 'Loaded profile for: $id',
      ),
    ),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `const Memo(super.dependency, super.builder)`  -- Creates a memoized boundary descriptor with [dependency] and [builder].

### Show  [class]
```dart
class Show extends ShowNode
```
Conditional rendering sugar.

Mounts [child] when [when] returns `true`, or [fallback] when `false`.

### DOM Representation
Mounts between sentinel comments `<!-- bloom:show -->` and `<!-- /bloom:show -->`.

```dart
final isLoggedIn = signal(false);

BloomNode authSection() => Show(
  () => isLoggedIn.value,
  child: Button(
    text: 'Log out',
    onClick: (e) => isLoggedIn.value = false,
  ),
  fallback: Button(
    text: 'Log in',
    onClick: (e) => isLoggedIn.value = true,
  ),
);
```

Members:
  - `const Show( super.when,`  -- Creates a conditional rendering boundary with predicate [when], [child],

### ForEach  [class]
```dart
class ForEach<T> extends ForEachNode<T>
```
Reactive list rendering sugar.

Renders a dynamic list of items. When [key] is supplied, enables fine-grained
DOM reconciliation, reusing elements for unchanged keys and only updating
insertions, deletions, and moves.

### DOM Representation
Mounts between sentinel comments `<!-- bloom:foreach -->` and `<!-- /bloom:foreach -->`.

```dart
class Todo {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  Todo(this.id, this.title);
}

final todos = signal<List<Todo>>([
  Todo('1', 'Buy milk'),
  Todo('2', 'Write tests'),
]);

BloomNode todoList() => Ul(
  children: [
    ForEach<Todo>(
      () => todos.value,
      (item) => Li(
        key: item.id,
        text: item.title,
      ),
      key: (item) => item.id,
    ),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `const ForEach( super.items, super.builder,`  -- Creates a reactive list descriptor with [items], [builder], and optional [key] extractor.

### Style  [class]
```dart
class Style extends StyleNode
```
Inline stylesheet sugar.

Emits a `<style>` block containing [css].

```dart
const customStyles = Style('''
  .custom-card {
    padding: 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #14141a;
  }
''');
```

Members:
  - `const Style(super.css)`  -- Creates an inline `<style>` element descriptor with [css].

### Raw  [class]
```dart
class Raw extends RawHtmlNode
```
Trusted raw HTML passthrough sugar.

Inserts raw HTML without entity escaping.

### Security Warning
**Never** pass untrusted or user-supplied input to [Raw]. In the browser,
this sets `.innerHTML` directly on a `<span>` wrapper element and bypasses
sanitization.

```dart
const mathSnippet = Raw('<math><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></semantics></math>');
```

Members:
  - `const Raw(super.html)`  -- Creates a raw HTML passthrough descriptor with [html].

### Ref  [class]
```dart
class Ref<T extends Object>
```
Reference holder for imperative access to mounted DOM elements.

Created before mounting and passed to a [RefNode] or component with ref support.
The browser mount engine automatically populates [value] when the DOM element
is created and attached, and resets it when unmounted.

### SSR Behavior
In SSR (`renderToHtml`), refs remain unpopulated and [isMounted] returns `false`.
Attempting to read [value] during SSR will throw a [StateError].

```dart
final inputRef = Ref<Object>();

BloomNode searchBox() => Mount(
  RefNode(
    inputRef,
    Input(placeholder: 'Search documentation...'),
  ),
  onMount: () {
    // Focus element when mounted in the browser
    if (inputRef.isMounted) {
      // Interop or custom logic with inputRef.value
    }
  },
);
```

Members:
  - `T get value => _value ?? (throw StateError('Ref<$T> not yet mounted'))`  -- The mounted DOM element instance.
  - `bool get isMounted => _value != null`  -- Whether this ref currently holds an active, mounted DOM element.
  - `void attach(T element) => _value = element`  -- Attaches [element] to this ref.
  - `void detach() => _value = null`  -- Detaches the element and resets this ref to unmounted state.

### MountNode  [class]
```dart
class MountNode extends BloomNode
```
Lifecycle boundary node that triggers callbacks on mount and unmount.

Executes [onMount] after the child tree is attached to the DOM, and
[onUnmount] when the subtree is removed or disposed.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: [onMount] is executed in a microtask immediately after
  DOM nodes are appended to the document. [onUnmount] is registered with the
  enclosing region and called when the region is torn down or rebuilt.
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Renders [child] only. Lifecycle callbacks [onMount]
  and [onUnmount] are intentionally ignored on the server.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Mount].

Members:
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The child descriptor tree enclosed by this lifecycle boundary.
  - `final void Function()? onMount`  -- Callback executed asynchronously in a microtask after [child] is inserted into the DOM.
  - `final void Function()? onUnmount`  -- Callback executed synchronously when [child] is removed from the DOM.
  - `const MountNode(this.child,`  -- Creates a lifecycle boundary descriptor wrapping [child] with optional [onMount] and [onUnmount].

### Mount  [class]
```dart
class Mount extends MountNode
```
DSL sugar for [MountNode].

Attaches lifecycle hooks to [child] for browser DOM mount and unmount events.

```dart
BloomNode timerWidget() => Mount(
  Div(text: 'Timer active'),
  onMount: () {
    print('Widget entered the DOM');
  },
  onUnmount: () {
    print('Widget left the DOM');
  },
);
```

Members:
  - `const Mount(super.child,`  -- Creates a lifecycle boundary wrapping [child] with optional [onMount] and [onUnmount] hooks.

### RefNode  [class]
```dart
class RefNode extends BloomNode
```
Attaches a [Ref] to the first `web.Element` created by [child].

In the browser, the mount engine inspects the DOM nodes emitted by [child],
attaches the first `Element` instance to [ref], and registers [Ref.detach]
into the region's disposer list to clear the ref when unmounted.

In SSR (`renderToHtml`), [child] renders normally and [ref] remains unattached.

```dart
final canvasRef = Ref<Object>();

BloomNode chart() => RefNode(
  canvasRef,
  Canvas(attrs: {'id': 'telemetry-canvas'}),
);
```

Members:
  - `final Ref<Object> ref`  -- The [Ref] instance to populate with the mounted DOM element.
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The child descriptor whose root DOM element will be attached to [ref].
  - `const RefNode(this.ref, this.child)`  -- Creates a [RefNode] connecting [ref] to the primary element emitted by [child].

### ErrorBoundaryNode  [class]
```dart
class ErrorBoundaryNode extends BloomNode
```
Catches exceptions during subtree rendering or reactive rebuilds
and renders [fallback] instead of crashing.

### DOM Mounting and Sentinels
In the browser, [ErrorBoundaryNode] mounts between sentinel comments:
`<!-- bloom:error-boundary -->` and `<!-- /bloom:error-boundary -->`.

Installs an ambient error boundary handler in the [Zone]. If [builder] throws
during initial mount, or if an unhandled error occurs during a nested reactive
update or [SuspenseNode] failure, the error is caught, the failed subtree's
resources are disposed, and [fallback] is mounted in place between the sentinels.
If [fallback] itself throws, the error bubbles up to the next enclosing error boundary.

### SSR Behavior
In SSR (`renderToHtml`), executes [builder] inside a `try/catch`. If an exception
is thrown, renders `fallback(err, stack)`.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [ErrorBoundary].

Members:
  - `final BloomNode Function() builder`  -- Factory building the primary subtree.
  - `final BloomNode Function(Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) fallback`  -- Fallback builder invoked with the caught [Object] error and [StackTrace] when [builder] fails.
  - `const ErrorBoundaryNode({ required this.builder, required this.fallback, })`  -- Creates an error boundary descriptor with [builder] and error [fallback].

### ErrorBoundary  [class]
```dart
class ErrorBoundary extends ErrorBoundaryNode
```
DSL sugar for [ErrorBoundaryNode].

Protects the application UI from crashing due to exceptions in child components
or nested reactive rebuilds.

```dart
BloomNode safeDashboard() => ErrorBoundary(
  builder: () => Div(
    children: [
      H1(text: 'Analytics'),
      riskyAnalyticsWidget(),
    ],
  ),
  fallback: (error, stack) => Div(
    className: 'error-banner',
    text: 'Failed to load dashboard: $error',
  ),
);
```

Members:
  - `const ErrorBoundary({ required super.builder, required super.fallback, })`  -- Creates an error boundary wrapping [builder] with [fallback].

### PortalNode  [class]
```dart
class PortalNode extends BloomNode
```
Renders [child] into a target DOM node outside the parent hierarchy
while maintaining parent reactive region lifecycle.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Queries the document for [targetSelector] (defaulting
  to `document.body` if unmatched) and appends the mounted DOM nodes of [child]
  into that target container. At the original AST position, it leaves a comment
  node `<!-- portal:targetSelector -->`. When the parent region is disposed,
  the portaled DOM nodes are cleaned up from the target container.
- **SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Emits `<template data-bloom-portal="targetSelector">child</template>`
  so client-side hydration or inspection tools can relocate portaled content.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Portal].

Members:
  - `final BloomNode child`  -- The descriptor tree to render into the target container.
  - `final String targetSelector`  -- The CSS selector identifying the destination container element (e.g. `'body'`, `'#modal-root'`).
  - `const PortalNode({ required this.child, this.targetSelector = 'body', })`  -- Creates a portal descriptor directing [child] to [targetSelector].

### Portal  [class]
```dart
class Portal extends PortalNode
```
DSL sugar for [PortalNode].

Renders overlays, modals, and tooltips directly into `document.body` or a
custom container while preserving lexical state and reactive lifecycle.

```dart
BloomNode modalDialog(bool isOpen) => Show(
  () => isOpen,
  child: Portal(
    targetSelector: 'body',
    child: Div(
      className: 'modal-backdrop',
      children: [
        Div(className: 'modal-card', text: 'Modal dialog content'),
      ],
    ),
  ),
);
```

Members:
  - `const Portal({ required super.child, super.targetSelector = 'body', })`  -- Creates a portal descriptor for [child] with destination [targetSelector].

### SuspenseNode  [class]
```dart
class SuspenseNode<T> extends BloomNode
```
Declarative async boundary that renders [fallback] while [resource] resolves.

### DOM Mounting and SSR
- **Browser (`mount`)**: Mounts between sentinel comments `<!-- bloom:suspense -->`
  and `<!-- /bloom:suspense -->`. Mounts [fallback] initially while asynchronously
  awaiting [resource]. When the future completes, disposes the fallback region
  and mounts `builder(data)` between the sentinels. If [resource] rejects,
  renders [errorBuilder] if provided or bubbles the error to the nearest [ErrorBoundary].
- **Streaming SSR (`renderToStreamWithSuspense`)**: Emits [fallback] in the
  initial HTML shell wrapped in `<div id="bloom-suspense-N">`. When [resource]
  resolutes on the server, streams an out-of-order `<script>` tag that replaces
  the fallback container's `outerHTML` with the resolved content.
- **Synchronous SSR (`renderToHtml`)**: Renders [fallback] only.

Usually created using the DSL sugar [Suspense].

Members:
  - `final Future<T> Function() resource`  -- Async factory returning a [Future] with the resolved data of type [T].
  - `final BloomNode Function(T data) builder`  -- Builder constructing the descriptor tree once [resource] resolves with [data].
  - `final BloomNode fallback`  -- Descriptor tree displayed while [resource] is still pending.
  - `final BloomNode Function(Object error, StackTrace stackTrace)? errorBuilder`  -- Optional error builder invoked if [resource] rejects with an exception.
  - `const SuspenseNode({ required this.resource, required this.builder, required this.fallback, this.errorBuilder, })`  -- Creates a suspense boundary descriptor with async [resource], resolved [builder],
  - `Future<Object?> Function() get resourceErased => resource`  -- [resource], viewed untyped as `Future<Object?> Function()`.
  - `BloomNode Function(Object? data) get builderErased =>`  -- [builder], accepting untyped resolved `Object?` data.

### Suspense  [class]
```dart
class Suspense<T> extends SuspenseNode<T>
```
DSL sugar for [SuspenseNode].

Renders [fallback] while async data is loading, and seamlessly swaps in
the resolved content when [resource] completes.

```dart
Future<String> fetchUsername() async {
  await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
  return 'Ada Lovelace';
}

BloomNode userProfile() => Suspense<String>(
  resource: fetchUsername,
  fallback: Div(className: 'skeleton-loader', text: 'Loading user...'),
  builder: (name) => Div(className: 'user-card', text: 'Welcome, $name!'),
  errorBuilder: (err, stack) => Div(text: 'Failed to load user: $err'),
);
```

Members:
  - `const Suspense({ required super.resource, required super.builder, required super.fallback, super.errorBuilder, })`  -- Creates a suspense boundary with async [resource], [builder], [fallback],

### cx  [function]
```dart
String cx(List<Object?> parts)
```
Conditional className builder — clsx-style utility.

Filters out `null`, `false`, and blank strings from [parts], trims each valid
class name, and joins the remaining entries with a single space.

```dart
final isActive = true;
final isDisabled = false;

final className = cx([
  'btn',
  isActive && 'btn-active',
  isDisabled && 'btn-disabled',
  null,
]);
// => 'btn btn-active'
```

### El  [class]
```dart
class El extends ElNode
```
Generic HTML / custom element constructor.

Provides convenient named event handler parameters ([onClick], [onInput],
[onChange], [onSubmit], etc.) that merge automatically into the element's
event registry.

Use [El] when emitting custom elements, web components, or HTML tags that do
not have a specialized sugar subclass in Bloom.

```dart
BloomNode customWidget() => El(
  'my-custom-element',
  className: 'custom-widget',
  attrs: {'data-mode': 'preview'},
  onClick: (e) => print('Clicked custom element'),
  children: [
    P(text: 'Inner text'),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `El( super.tag,`  -- Creates an element with [tag] and optional styling, attributes, event handlers,
  - `const El.raw( super.tag,`  -- Const constructor for [El] when no event callback shorthand is needed.

### Button  [class]

```dart
class Button extends ElNode
```

### Input  [class]
```dart
class Input extends ElNode
```
`<input>` — interactive form input control element.

**Void element**: `<input>` cannot have children and is emitted without a closing tag.

### Reactivity Pattern
Setting [value] configures the initial HTML attribute. For two-way data binding,
listen with [onInput] or [onChange] and update a `Signal`:

```dart
final query = signal('');

BloomNode searchInput() => Input(
  placeholder: 'Search items...',
  value: query.value,
  onInput: (e) => query.value = (e.target as dynamic).value,
);
```

Members:
  - `Input({ super.className, super.style, Map<String, String>? attrs, String? placeholder, String? value, String? type, bool? checked, bool? disabled, String? name, Map<String, BloomEventHandler>? on, BloomEventHandler? onInput, BloomEventHandler? onChange, BloomEventHandler? onClick, BloomEventHandler? onKeyDown, BloomEventHandler? onKeyUp, BloomEventHandler? onKeyPress, BloomEventHandler? onFocus, BloomEventHandler? onBlur, }) : super( 'input', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an `<input>` element descriptor with attribute and event shorthands.
  - `const Input.raw({ super.className, super.style, super.attrs, super.on, }) : super('input')`  -- Const constructor for `<input>` without attribute and event shorthands.

### Textarea  [class]
```dart
class Textarea extends ElNode
```
`<textarea>` — multi-line plain text editing control element.

In Bloom, [value] sets the initial text attribute shorthand. For interactive
updates, attach an [onInput] handler to synchronize state with a `Signal`.

```dart
final note = signal('');

BloomNode noteField() => Textarea(
  rows: 4,
  placeholder: 'Enter notes here...',
  onInput: (e) => note.value = (e.target as dynamic).value,
);
```

Members:
  - `Textarea({ super.className, super.style, Map<String, String>? attrs, String? placeholder, String? value, String? name, int? rows, int? cols, Map<String, BloomEventHandler>? on, BloomEventHandler? onInput, BloomEventHandler? onChange, BloomEventHandler? onFocus, BloomEventHandler? onBlur, BloomEventHandler? onKeyDown, BloomEventHandler? onKeyUp, }) : super( 'textarea', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates a `<textarea>` element descriptor with attribute and event shorthands.
  - `const Textarea.raw({ super.className, super.style, super.attrs, super.on, }) : super('textarea')`  -- Const constructor for `<textarea>` without attribute and event shorthands.

### A  [class]
```dart
class A extends ElNode
```
`<a>` — anchor / hyperlink element.

Provides convenient shorthands for [href], [target], and [rel].

```dart
A(
  href: 'https://bloom.dev',
  target: '_blank',
  rel: 'noopener noreferrer',
  text: 'Visit Bloom',
)
```

Members:
  - `A({ super.text, super.className, super.style, Map<String, String>? attrs, String? href, String? target, String? rel, super.children = const [], Map<String, BloomEventHandler>? on, BloomEventHandler? onClick, BloomEventHandler? onMouseEnter, BloomEventHandler? onMouseLeave, BloomEventHandler? onFocus, BloomEventHandler? onBlur, }) : super( 'a', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an `<a>` anchor element descriptor with hyperlink shorthands.
  - `const A.raw({ super.text, super.className, super.style, super.attrs, super.on, super.children = const [], }) : super('a')`  -- Const constructor for `<a>` without hyperlink shorthands.

### Select  [class]
```dart
class Select extends ElNode
```
`<select>` — control that provides a menu of options.

Contains child [Option] and [Optgroup] descriptors. Supports [onChange],
[onFocus], and [onBlur] event shorthands.

```dart
final selectedRole = signal('developer');

BloomNode roleSelector() => Select(
  name: 'role',
  onChange: (e) => selectedRole.value = (e.target as dynamic).value,
  children: [
    Option(value: 'developer', text: 'Developer'),
    Option(value: 'designer', text: 'Designer'),
    Option(value: 'manager', text: 'Manager'),
  ],
);
```

Members:
  - `Select({ String? name, bool? multiple, bool? disabled, super.className, super.style, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.children = const [], Map<String, BloomEventHandler>? on, BloomEventHandler? onChange, BloomEventHandler? onFocus, BloomEventHandler? onBlur, }) : super( 'select', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates a `<select>` drop-down control descriptor.

### SvgNode  [class]
```dart
class SvgNode extends ElNode
```
SVG element node base class.

All SVG descriptors inherit from [SvgNode]. In the browser, elements are
created within the SVG XML namespace (`http://www.w3.org/2000/svg`) rather than
the standard HTML namespace.

Members:
  - `const SvgNode( super.tag,`  -- Creates an SVG element descriptor with [tag].

### Svg  [class]
```dart
class Svg extends SvgNode
```

```dart

  viewBox: '0 0 24 24',
  width: '24',
  height: '24',
  children: [
    SvgPath(d: 'M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z', fill: 'currentColor'),
  ],
)
```

Members:
  - `Svg({ String? viewBox, String? width, String? height, super.className, super.style, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.children = const [], super.on, }) : super('svg', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an `<svg>` viewport container descriptor.

Members:
  - `SvgCircle({ required num cx, required num cy, required num r, String? fill, String? stroke, super.className, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.on, }) : super('circle', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an SVG `<circle>` shape descriptor.
  - `const SvgCircle.raw({ super.className, super.attrs, super.on, }) : super('circle')`  -- Const constructor for SVG `<circle>` without attribute shorthands.

### SvgRect  [class]
```dart
class SvgRect extends SvgNode
```
`<rect>` — SVG rectangle shape element.

Requires [width] and [height]. Supports [x], [y], corner radius [rx],
[fill], and [stroke] shorthands.

Members:
  - `SvgRect({ num? x, num? y, required num width, required num height, num? rx, String? fill, String? stroke, super.className, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.on, }) : super('rect', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an SVG `<rect>` rectangle shape descriptor.
  - `const SvgRect.raw({ super.className, super.attrs, super.on, }) : super('rect')`  -- Const constructor for SVG `<rect>` without attribute shorthands.

### SvgLine  [class]
```dart
class SvgLine extends SvgNode
```
`<line>` — SVG straight line element.

Requires start coordinates [x1], [y1] and end coordinates [x2], [y2].

Members:
  - `SvgLine({ required num x1, required num y1, required num x2, required num y2, String? stroke, super.className, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.on, }) : super('line', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an SVG `<line>` segment descriptor.

### SvgText  [class]
```dart
class SvgText extends SvgNode
```
`<text>` — SVG graphical text element.

Members:
  - `SvgText({ super.text, num? x, num? y, String? fill, super.className, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.on, super.children = const [], }) : super('text', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an SVG `<text>` element descriptor with [x], [y], and [fill] shorthands.

```dart
class SvgUse extends SvgNode
```
`<use>` — SVG element instance reuse element.

  - `SvgUse({ required String href, num? x, num? y, super.className, Map<String, String>? attrs, super.on, }) : super('use', attrs: _mergeAttrs(attrs,`  -- Creates an SVG `<use>` instance reuse descriptor.
